lines.zh: 我贴着地跑，肚子快擦到土。
lines.en: I run low, my belly nearly scraping the dirt.
I trot along in quick, short steps.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转半圈，再靠近。
lines.en: I circle half around you, then close in.

lines.zh: 我踩着枯草过去，声音很轻。
lines.en: I cross the dead grass with very little sound.
I advance in little darts.
I slip out from behind a stone.

lines.zh: 我在地面上一路嗅过去。
lines.en: I sniff my way along the ground.
I am faster than I look.
I do not slip on the gravel.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，从低处过来。
lines.en: I keep low and come in under cover.
I watch you as I run.
I crouch with my ears up.
My tail jerks behind me.
I am gnawing at something.

lines.zh: 这一片荒地没什么吃的。
lines.en: There is little to eat in this wasteland.
All my teeth are bared.
I tuck against a stone.
I am small, but I am mean.
My claws take the dirt.

lines.zh: 我看了你一眼，又低下头。
lines.en: I glance at you and look down.
I tilt my head at you, teeth showing.
You are bigger than I thought.
I am still not going anywhere.
I am looking at your legs.

lines.zh: 我的前爪往前跑了半步。
lines.en: My front paws carried me half a step in.
I am not the least bit scared.
One step back from you and I take one.
This ground is mine.

lines.zh: 我从石缝后探出头，看你的脚踝。
lines.en: I poke my head from a crevice and eye your ankle.
I shriek and spring aside.
I rolled over and came up again.
I clench my teeth and back two steps.
The pain made me gasp.
I rolled up into a ball.
I press to the ground, panting fast.
I bared my teeth again.
I am not running; I am still here.
I begin to circle.
Food? Give it here.
You have no use for that.
I snatch it and run.
That smell is very good.
I eat while keeping watch.
This is not enough for me.
You still have some in your hand.
I will bite your fingers.

lines.zh: 你一脚把我踢翻，我立刻爬起。
lines.en: Your kick flips me over, and I scramble up.
I am up at once.
I bite your boot.
That only made me meaner.
I back off two steps and come again.
I am too small to hurt you with a bump.
I duck low out of the way.
Do not kick at me.
I have pressed in again.
My claws slip on the ground.
I do nothing else at this time of year.
I have left my scent in the waste.
We part again quickly.
I do not call; I only come close.

lines.zh: 我朝空废土叫了两声，没人应。
lines.en: I call twice across the empty waste; nothing answers.
I duck back into the burrow.
We have scratched the soil open.
The season is short as a breath.
I nip its ear.
I snatch it and run.
Not edible; I drop it.
This can go back to the burrow.
I crush it with my teeth.
Too big to drag.
I hide it.
I went up and sniffed it.
This one is mine.
I take it and back off.
I go still with my head down.

lines.zh: 你在废土上踩出声音，我听见了。
lines.en: Your steps on the wasteland give you away.
My hind legs snapped taut as a string.
I am crouched to spring.
This waste answers to me.

lines.zh: 我伏在枯草里，眼睛盯住你。
lines.en: I crouch in the dry grass, eyes fixed on you.
I broke into a run.
I go for your legs.
Retreat and I still follow.
I have picked where to bite.
I lower myself and gather.
There is no one else here.
You are not walking away from me.
I grin, all teeth.
Here I come.

lines.zh: 我跟着你跑，一直在低处。
lines.en: I follow you, always low.
You go left; I cut left.

lines.zh: 我一直贴着你的脚后跟。
lines.en: I stay right at your heels.

lines.zh: 我绕着你小跑，找能下口的地方。
lines.en: I trot circles around you, looking for a place to bite.
I am not quick, but I do not rest.
I bite at your heel.
There is no cover in this waste.

lines.zh: 你脚下有石头，慢了一点。
lines.en: You slowed on the loose stone.
I keep my eyes on your legs.

lines.zh: 你跑到荒地边上也没用。
lines.en: Reaching the waste's edge will not help.
I do not need to change direction.
The distance shrinks with every stride.
I herd you toward the rocks.
You are starting to pant.
All four feet have left the ground.
I bite your ankle.
I leap and hit your leg.
I tear with my teeth.
That bite went in deep.
I latch onto your leg.

lines.zh: 我扑上你的小腿，牙嵌进去。
lines.en: I leap at your calf and sink my teeth in.
Your kick sent me rolling.
Blood is on my muzzle.
Your feet are unsteady now.
This time I want your leg.
I pant hard, teeth still in.
I lunged a second time.
That bite found your knee.
You have dropped down.
I am on your back.
That was a filthy bite.

lines.zh: 土堆翻了一下，我钻出来。
lines.en: The mound turns over and I come out.
I rise out of the dead grass.

lines.zh: 石头边上多了一个小影子。
lines.en: A small shadow appears by the stone.
I call first.
This waste is very empty.

lines.zh: 废土的小兽，抖落一身土。
lines.en: A small wasteland beast shakes off dirt.

lines.zh: 地上的碎石被我踩响了。
lines.en: The gravel rattles under me.

lines.zh: 我摸到这块荒地上来了。
lines.en: I have come onto this waste.
I flatten and start to run.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，我满地打滚。
lines.en: Fire catches my fur; I roll on the ground.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，半天爬不起来。
lines.en: I fall from a height and cannot get up for a while.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴，我乱蹬着往外。
lines.en: Water floods my mouth; I kick wildly out.
The blast throws me against a stone.
Something lodges in my side.

lines.zh: 一股力按住我，我挣了出来。
lines.en: Some force held me down; I wrenched free.
Hunger turns my legs to water.

lines.zh: 雷砸下来，我四条腿都软了。
lines.en: Lightning fell and all four legs went slack.
There is no soil and nothing to grip.
